newsitem.title: JAPAN: Canon Inc sees average dlr rate of 115 yen in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Canon Inc sees average dlr rate of 115 yen in 1997.

text.p: Japan's Canon Inc said on Wednesday that it expects the dollar to trade at an average rate of 115 yen in 1997.
The firm forecast an average rate of 108 yen to the dollar for 1996.
The new forecast was given at a news conference by Canon director Tokuzo Tanaka.
"We expect the dollar/yen rate to average 115 yen for the whole year as we expect the difference in interest rates between the United States and Japan to shrink in the latter half of the year."
Record-low interest rates in Japan have been a factor in the weakening of the yen to its current level of 124 yen to the dollar.
